daily_thesis: The 2026-09-22 batch says robot policies are no longer judged by whether they work once, but by whether their evidence contract survives counterfactual stress. VLA and driving papers turn visual perturbation regions, stale cameras, task-semantic swaps, offline compression metrics, and counterfactual pedestrian edits into closed-loop validation gates. Contact-rich manipulation papers make touch, wrench, force residuals, and imagined contact futures into authority signals that can refine or override a nominal action. Geometry and SLAM papers ask when registration, next-best-view, elevator transport state, predictive frontiers, uncertainty, and wide-view priors are trustworthy enough to move. Navigation, world-model, and safety papers then expose the hidden interfaces: phase progress, module dependence, action encoding, simulator queries, safety barriers, and recovery data must all be tested against the specific command they are allowed to change.

clusters.cluster: VLA validation moves from nominal score to counterfactual closed-loop evidence
clusters.why: 기존 VLA/주행 평가는 clean benchmark score나 sampled corruption으로 안정성을 말했지만, 오늘 묶음은 어떤 counterfactual evidence가 실제 action을 바꾸는지 묻는다. Validating, Not Sampling은 연속 perturbation region을 검증하고, LIBERO-VPro는 stale camera와 task-relevant scene variation을 closed-loop로 넣으며, Beyond the Leaderboard는 pedestrian edit과 relighting으로 policy profile을 분해한다. MaskVLA, BAS-VLA, CARE, Closed-Loop Collapse 논문은 trajectory overfitting, semantic-preserving/breaking 변화, recovery state, offline compression gate가 서로 다른 실패 축임을 보여준다. APRL은 success rate 앞에 perturbation region, stale evidence, semantic swap, action-trace residual, recovery trigger를 독립 gate로 세워야 한다.
clusters.confidence_note: Region validation, visual robustness benchmark, counterfactual driving diagnosis, semantic calibration, compression collapse, and corrective execution repeat the closed-loop evidence contract.
clusters.lab_action: LIBERO/RoboCasa/NAVSIM류 task에서 brightness/rotation region, camera staleness, local cue disruption, pedestrian counterfactual, task-semantic swap, compression residual, and post-failure correction을 stress split으로 만들고 action change, first failure cue, recovery success, false veto, and task success를 함께 비교한다.

clusters.cluster: Contact-rich manipulation turns touch and force into command authority
clusters.why: Contact-rich manipulation은 RGB가 보는 상태와 물리적으로 중요한 상태가 다르기 때문에, touch와 force가 단순 보조 feature인지 command를 바꿀 authority인지가 핵심이다. DexTacWAM은 contact evolution을 predicted world state로 넣고, HapticWAM은 inference-time tactile 없이도 imagined contact package를 남기며, When Does Touch Matter?는 wrench와 taxel feedback이 비전-only grasp와 다른 조건을 분리한다. InsertAnything, ContactDP, ForceRFT, CompVLA, TACIT은 tight insertion, force residual, compliance, tactile attention supervision을 실제 action refinement로 연결한다. 따라서 APRL manipulation 평가는 touch를 붙였는지가 아니라 어떤 contact signal이 action chunk를 언제 바꾸는지로 설계해야 한다.
clusters.confidence_note: Visuo-tactile WAM, imagined touch, real-world tactile/wrench comparison, precision insertion, contact diffusion, force residual, compliance VLA, and tactile supervision share the contact-authority axis.

clusters.cluster: Geometry systems shift from reconstruction fidelity to uncertainty-aware motion commitment
clusters.why: Geometry 논문들은 더 선명한 3D reconstruction보다 robot motion을 허용할 만큼 evidence가 믿을 만한지를 묻는다. ZIL은 image-to-LiDAR registration을 zero-shot/non-synchronized 조건으로 밀고, Splat-CBF는 Gaussian map의 uncertainty 안에서 next-best-view와 collision safety를 같은 QP에 넣으며, Elevator-VIGS는 elevator transport state를 robot motion과 분리한다. WOLF와 BayesianGS-SLAM은 predictive frontiers와 predictive surprise를 통해 어디를 볼지, 어떤 residual을 믿을지 결정하고, When Wider Views Fail과 LiDAR-language 논문은 foundation geometry prior가 넓은 view나 spatio-temporal 관계에서 깨지는 조건을 드러낸다. APRL map 평가는 PSNR/ATE만이 아니라 uncertainty가 실제 move/stop/view 선택을 바꿨는지를 봐야 한다.
clusters.confidence_note: Registration, safe NBV, visual-inertial GS-SLAM, LiDAR predictive exploration, uncertainty-aware SLAM, and wide-view stress testing all expose motion-commitment evidence.
clusters.lab_action: LiDAR-camera registration, 3DGS map, visual-inertial elevator sequence, UAV LiDAR exploration, RGB-D neural SLAM, feed-forward reconstruction, and LiDAR-language relation tests에서 synchronization gap, view span, uncertainty threshold, transport-state model, predictive frontier, keyframe surprise, and downstream navigation success를 함께 비교한다.

clusters.cluster: Embodied navigation separates evidence gathering, phase progress, and system-level calibration
clusters.why: Navigation batch는 goal-reaching score를 하나로 보지 말고, evidence를 더 모을지, semantic phase를 넘길지, module uncertainty를 composition할지, graph commitment를 할지 분리하라고 말한다. Active Spatial Inspection은 cue sufficiency와 further inspection을 explicit하게 만들고, RiverVLN은 USV instruction을 visually verifiable semantic phases로 바꾸며, Marginal Calibration Does Not Compose는 component calibration이 downstream navigation uncertainty로 보존되지 않음을 보인다. Object-Path Graphs, Selective Commitment, Commonsense path planning, structured robotic search는 dense map 없이도 belief, graph, feasibility, abstention을 commitment rule로 삼는다. APRL navigation 평가는 final SPL보다 evidence-gathering cost, phase error, calibration dependence, false grasp/false defer, and graph-localization failure를 함께 기록해야 한다.
clusters.confidence_note: Inspection, USV phase-grounded VLN, modular calibration, topological object navigation, selective commitment, and robotic search converge on evidence-gated commitment.

clusters.cluster: World models are being audited at the action interface, not by future-video quality alone
clusters.why: World model 논문들은 미래 영상을 얼마나 잘 그리느냐보다, 그 representation이 어떤 action interface를 안정화하는지를 검증한다. DualWAM, OnlineWM, What Matters in Designing WAM, D-JEPA, AR-WAM은 global planning/local refinement, causal simulator query, representation choice, decision-aligned latent, visual-conditioned agent-ready WAM을 각각 action contract로 만든다. APRL은 generated future quality보다 action parameterization, causality, affordance target, and local feedback이 실제 command를 어떻게 바꾸는지 평가해야 한다.

clusters.cluster: Safety and recovery move from current-step vetoes to predictive control authority
clusters.why: Safety 논문들은 현재 action을 veto하는 필터에서 벗어나, 미래에 recovery authority가 남는지를 예측하고 그 근거를 control interface에 넣으려 한다. VLPSA는 perception-derived Poisson safety functions를 CBF-QP로 enforced full-body safety에 연결하고, FRAMES와 REBOOT는 humanoid/assembly failure를 monitoring과 phase-level recovery data로 만든다. BarrierFormer와 adaptive conformal quantile intervals는 predictive barrier와 calibrated uncertainty를 통해 future constraint violation을 줄이며, DriveReferee는 learned verdict 대신 predicted scene state 위에서 explicit geometric rule을 적용한다. APRL safety 평가는 collision avoided yes/no보다 warning latency, remaining control authority, uncertainty coverage, phase-specific recovery, and false conservatism을 같이 봐야 한다.
clusters.confidence_note: CBF filtering, humanoid monitoring, recovery benchmark, predictive barrier transformer, conformal safety, MPC repair, analytic driving referee, and HRI recovery all make future authority explicit.
clusters.lab_action: Manipulation, humanoid loco-manipulation, mobile navigation, driving WAM, and HRI recovery tasks에서 CBF activation, monitor decision, recovery phase, conformal interval width, predictive barrier horizon, analytic geometric verdict, and human help timing을 stress split으로 두고 unsafe execution, false stop, task delay, and recovery success를 비교한다.

frontier_memory.label: Strengthening
frontier_memory.history: September 21 emphasized early evidence timing for VLA failure, contact, mapping, social navigation, and recovery authority.
frontier_memory.body: September 22 strengthens the same axis, but shifts from first warning time to validation contracts: perturbation regions, stale evidence, tactile authority, uncertainty-aware maps, and action-encoding invariance.

frontier_memory.label: New signal
frontier_memory.history: Recent reports treated tactile WAMs and safety filters as separate lines.
frontier_memory.body: Today they converge: touch, force, barrier rollouts, conformal uncertainty, and recovery data all act as gates that decide whether a nominal command keeps authority.

frontier_memory.label: Commoditizing
frontier_memory.history: VLA, WAM, 3DGS, and Gaussian SLAM now recur almost every run.
frontier_memory.body: The differentiator is no longer proposing one of these backbones; it is proving which interface variable survives closed-loop stress and changes the robot action.

frontier_memory.label: Contradiction
frontier_memory.history: Leaderboard and nominal benchmark progress often imply that better models transfer directly.
frontier_memory.body: Counterfactual driving, closed-loop VLA collapse, LIBERO-VPro, and region validation argue that nominal success can be almost orthogonal to deployment behavior.

frontier_memory.label: Missing axis
frontier_memory.history: The repo has many per-modality diagnostics but few cross-modality arbitration rules.
frontier_memory.body: A shared arbitration benchmark is still missing: when camera, touch, map uncertainty, action encoding, and safety filter disagree, which signal should own the next command?

strategy_board.title: Closed-loop evidence contract benchmark
strategy_board.thesis: Build one suite where VLA actions are tested under perturbation regions, stale/missing camera evidence, task-semantic swaps, and compressed-policy rollout checks.
strategy_board.one_week: Run LIBERO-style tasks with brightness/rotation regions, camera staleness, object swap, and one compressed policy baseline.
strategy_board.four_week: Add driving-style counterfactual edits, action-trace residual forensics, and task-semantic calibration labels across manipulation and navigation.
strategy_board.success: The suite separates at least two policies that have similar nominal success but different closed-loop failure families.
strategy_board.stop: Stop if all axes collapse to generic confidence or clean success and do not change recovery choices.
strategy_board.paper_path: Benchmark paper on counterfactual closed-loop validation for robotic foundation models.
strategy_board.asset_path: Perturbation-region certificates, stale-camera episodes, semantic-swap labels, action traces, and recovery outcomes.
strategy_board.asset: Perturbation-region certificates, stale-camera episodes, semantic-swap labels, action traces, and recovery outcomes.

strategy_board.title: Contact authority ladder for manipulation
strategy_board.thesis: Rank vision, imagined touch, real tactile features, force residuals, and contact diffusion by when each should override the nominal action.
strategy_board.one_week: Compare vision-only, wrench, taxel, and imagined-touch signals on cluttered grasping and one insertion task.
strategy_board.four_week: Add DexTacWAM-style tactile world modeling, HapticWAM-style distillation, ForceRFT residual correction, and ContactDP insertion trials.
strategy_board.success: At least one contact channel predicts and corrects slip, jam, or force overshoot before the final failure.
strategy_board.stop: Stop if tactile signals improve offline prediction but cannot change recovery timing or reduce peak force.
strategy_board.paper_path: Manipulation paper on contact evidence as command authority for VLA/WAM policies.
strategy_board.asset_path: Synchronized RGB, tactile, wrench, contact package, action residual, and task-outcome logs.
strategy_board.asset: Synchronized RGB, tactile, wrench, contact package, action residual, and task-outcome logs.

strategy_board.title: Evidence-budgeted maps and world models
strategy_board.thesis: Audit when a robot should buy more geometry, query a simulator, trust a SLAM residual, or change the action parameterization before committing motion.
strategy_board.one_week: Run Splat-CBF, BayesianGS-SLAM uncertainty, and action-encoding invariance tests on one small navigation/manipulation environment.
strategy_board.four_week: Add ZIL registration, WOLF predictive frontiers, Elevator-VIGS transport-state stress, OnlineWM counterfactual simulator queries, and DualWAM local refinement.
strategy_board.success: Extra evidence or interface repair improves downstream safety or task success more than its time/compute cost.
strategy_board.stop: Stop if map/world-model metrics improve but route commitment, collision avoidance, or contact recovery do not.
strategy_board.paper_path: Systems paper on evidence budgets and hidden interface contracts in robot world models.
strategy_board.asset_path: View-selection logs, uncertainty maps, action-encoding pairs, simulator query traces, and downstream action changes.
strategy_board.asset: View-selection logs, uncertainty maps, action-encoding pairs, simulator query traces, and downstream action changes.
